crossRefs.note: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.
I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.
Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.
even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.
For I, Yahweh your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’
I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.
My Father who has given them to me is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.
Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has…
who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in…
Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.
I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes.
I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end.

translations.web: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.
translations.bsb: Uphold me, and I will be saved, that I may always regard Your statutes.
translations.kjv: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.
translations.asv: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe, And shall have respect unto thy statutes continually.
